titulo: VITACHY Double Soap Dispenser for Kitchen. Dishwashing Soap Pump Dispenser and Hand Dispenser Sink Organizer Sponge Holder Black Kitchen and Bathroom Accessory
bullets: CONVENIENT: If you’ve never used a soap dispenser in the kitchen, we highly recommend trying it. You’ll never go back to dispensing dishwashing soap directly from the bottle again.
DOUBLE DISPENSER: Equipped with two independent 350ml tanks, it allows you to use different types of liquid soap according to your needs.
ALL TYPES OF LIQUIDS: You can dispense soap and any other liquid you need on hand, such as disinfectant, glass cleaner, or even alcohol.
RELIABLE AND DURABLE: This dispenser is built to last, featuring two robust dosing pumps that can withstand up to 10,000 cycles.
VERSATILE: The back of the dispenser includes two compartments for storing a scouring pad and a brush, helping to keep your sink area tidy.

EASY TO CLEAN: The product can be fully disassembled for thorough cleaning. It is easily assembled and disassembled by hand. Any water that drips from the scouring pad or cloth is collected in a liquid collection tank that can be emptied without removal.
SAVINGS: The soap dosage is consistent, leading to substantial savings on dishwashing soap.

Product Advantages</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Double Soap Dispenser</strong>: This dispenser features two 350 ml tanks, allowing you to store both hand soap and dishwashing soap in one convenient place. It’s perfect for keeping your kitchen organized and functional.</li> <li><strong>Modern and Compact Design</strong>: With its sleek and modern design, this dispenser complements any kitchen style. Its compact size ensures it doesn’t take up much counter space, maintaining a clean and tidy appearance. </li> <li><strong>Easy to Use</strong>: The tanks can be refilled without disassembling the dispenser. Simply unscrew the pumps to fill them with soap. </li> <li><strong>Easy Assembly and Disassembly</strong>: The dispenser is easy to assemble and disassemble, allowing for thorough cleaning when necessary. This ensures the product remains hygienic and in perfect condition. </li> <li><strong>Storage Compartments</strong>: Includes two small rear compartments for storing scouring pads, small sponges, brushes, and other cleaning utensils, keeping them always at hand and organized. </li> </ul> <p><strong>2. High Quality Material</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>HIPS Housing</strong>: The housing is made of HIPS (High Impact Polystyrene), known for its mechanical and chemical resistance. The dispenser is built to last, with a robust and unalterable structure. </li> <li><strong>PET Tanks</strong>: The tanks are made of PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate), a lightweight and durable plastic that is easy to clean and does not retain odors. This ensures the soap stays fresh and free of contaminants. </li> <li><strong>ABS Dispenser Pumps</strong>: The dispenser pumps are made of ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene), a robust and durable material that ensures longevity and reliability. </li> <li><strong>Non-Slip Base</strong>: The base of the dispenser is firm and stable on all types of surfaces, providing safety and stability during use. </li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Contribution to the Environment</strong></p> Using reusable dispensers significantly reduces plastic waste. The issue is not the use of plastic, but its overuse. Plastic is one of the best materials for resisting heat, humidity, and chemical agents without oxidation or corrosion, and it withstands severe impacts. Without plastic, our quality of life would not be the same. However, the overuse of small, non-reusable containers is causing serious environmental problems. We must transition to a model that uses fewer single-use containers and more functional devices to dispense products. <br> <p><strong>4. Convenience</strong></p> Using a dispenser is much more convenient than dispensing dishwashing soap directly from the bottle. This is especially true for older individuals who may have less hand strength. Soap dispensers in the kitchen offer a transition towards greater comfort, similar to the shift from hand soaps to dispensers. Dispensers make kitchen tasks easier and eliminate the need to keep the bottle on the counter. <br> <p><strong>5. Assembly and Maintenance Tips</strong></p> Screw Pumps Completely: To avoid soap leaks, ensure the pumps are screwed on completely. This ensures a tight seal and optimal operation. Proper Cleaning: To maintain the dispenser’s shine and appearance, clean it with a soft cloth and avoid using scouring pads or items that can scratch its surface. This will keep it looking like new.
